tools.name: find_gene

tools.name: genes_in_region
tools.description:
Genes overlapping a region of one Ensembl Plants genome (max 5 Mb). species is an Ensembl name, e.g.
'brassica_rapa' (chromosomes A01-A10) or 'brassica_oleracea' (C1-C9); chromosome names as in that assembly. Brassica napus is scaffold-level in Ensembl Plants (Darmor-bzh v4.1), so use B. rapa or B.

tools.name: orthologues

tools.name: snp_lines
tools.description:
Find SNP-genotyped lines in CropSNPdb by name or AGG accession (e.g. 'Westar', 'Darmor').
Returns line name, accession(s), country, pedigree, status, breeding organisation and donor. dataset: 'Brassica napus Darmor v81' (default, 459 lines), 'Brassica napus Darmor v41', 'Brassica rapa v3', 'Brassica

tools.name: snp_genotypes
tools.description:
SNP genotype calls for up to 50 lines in a region (chromosome like 'A01'). Returns markers with positions
and each line's call. Keep regions small (a few Mb) for many lines.

tools.name: snp_compare_lines
tools.description:
Compare two lines' SNP genotypes on a chromosome (optionally a region): markers compared, identical,
different, % identity and the regions where they differ (useful for pedigree/introgression questions).

tools.name: snp_haplotype_carriers
tools.description:
Lines that share a reference line's SNP haplotype in a region (max 5 Mb), e.g. which genebank lines carry the
Westar haplotype around a gene. Only markers polymorphic in the panel (minor allele frequency >= min_maf) are
used, and a match needs calls at >= min_called of them with at most max_mismatch

tools.name: snp_markers
tools.description: SNP array markers (IDs and positions) in a region, with the total count.

tools.description:
Full record for one paper: DOI (10.xxxx/..), PMID (digits) or PMCID (PMC...). Returns the abstract,
open-access status and full-text links.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_data, annotate_genes, brassica_gene_view · Private data: search_data, find_germplasm, data_sources, snp_phenotypes, get_paper, brapi_germplasm_studies, blast_sequence · Public sink: snp_haplotype_carriers, brassica_gene_view.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
